answer: Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the saffron of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, slashed on a failed audit. Each submission hangs on the voyage of a task receipt, and the vine is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
